description:
Close the epic with deterministic cross-package acceptance coverage, documentation, and a real TUI smoke after all implementation slices land.

## Purpose

Individual children own their unit/regression tests. This issue proves the integrated operator and parent-model behavior as one product without inventing another runtime or duplicating implementation logic.

## Deterministic acceptance scenario

Extend the existing in-process minions/Beadwork harness rather than creating a second harness. With fake child sessions and no paid model:

1. Discover bundled `worker` and `investigate` without user files; prove a project override wins.
2. From an active parent-model turn, call `beadwork_start_goal({ epic_id })` for a decomposed epic. Prove it establishes the same persisted goal/scope/review-policy state as `/bw run`, queues one follow-up, and does not itself start a ticket or child.
3. On continuation, launch two implementation children using canonical `agent: "worker"` plus taskType/domain metadata.
4. Observe registration as pending/starting, then confirmed running after child handles exist.
5. Parent continues manager-only orchestration and does not edit delegated ticket scope.
6. Human fleet component receives meaningful tool/settling activity snapshots; no `turn N` overwrite.
7. A child notifies the parent without waiting for a reply, entering a parked state, or delaying ordinary settlement; parent-to-child mail remains best-effort only while the child is live.
8. Multiple simultaneous live children may intentionally share one opaque/advisory `domain.workItemId`.
9. Implementation children return atomic commit SHAs; parent starts reviewers only after implementers settle and reviewers inspect named commits.
10. Reviewer completion nudges the parent to assess findings against product goals and constraints rather than accepting them verbatim or allowing adversarial hardening to expand behavior without product confirmation.
11. Near-simultaneous final child settlements produce one follow-up lifecycle packet with a bounded snapshot and one group-idle adjudication boundary.
12. Settlement/group idle does not close tickets or claim goal success; scripted parent applies review policy and mutates Beadwork state.
13. All-rejected orchestrate registration creates no empty group and renders rejection truthfully.
14. Start failure after registration becomes failed without unhandled rejection.
15. Foreground spawn remains blocking, uses canonical agent/defaults, and never appears in orchestrated group packets.
16. A planning/decomposition-only scenario does not auto-call `beadwork_start_goal`; goal entry remains an explicit parent decision.
17. Superseded supervisor state, tracked-worker/run summaries, tmux/current-branch attribution surfaces, and commit heuristics are absent and old persisted fields are dropped rather than reserialized.

Log each step with timestamp, child/group/issue ids, goal-entry source, registration and terminal state, activity phase, packet count/seq, and issue status. On failure dump the persisted goal/scope, last fleet snapshot, packets, active tools, prompt appendix, and relevant Beadwork issue state. Keep logging in the test harness, not production telemetry.

## Documentation

Update `packages/pi-minions/README.md`, `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/README.md`, and relevant operator/migration docs to describe:

- canonical `agent` selector and removal of `role`
- built-in worker/investigate behavior and override precedence
- `beadwork_start_goal({ epic_id })` as the agent entrypoint equivalent to human `/bw run`, including explicit-use criteria and truthful start/resume semantics
- registration vs liveness vs settlement
- child-to-parent notification as nonblocking with no parked-child/reply protocol
- opaque/advisory domain metadata with no workItem assignment permit
- persistent fleet widget and `/minions` drill-down
- sidecar boundary, manager-only Beadwork mode, and group-idle-as-adjudication semantics
- reviewer findings as evidence requiring product-context adjudication
- deleted supervisor/current-branch/tmux state and migration notes
- migration notes for callers using `orchestrate.role`

Keep `docs/proposals/agent-friendly-improvements-reco.md` as historical recommendation; implementation docs are authoritative after release.

## Manual TUI smoke

In a real persistent Pi TUI:

- initiate one goal through `beadwork_start_goal` from the parent model and confirm the queued continuation matches `/bw run` behavior
- launch at least two children, including one orchestrated `worker`, and allow two live children to share a workItemId
- confirm widget appears without `/minions`, does not capture input, updates useful activity, handles narrow width, and clears at idle
- confirm a child-to-parent notification wakes/informs without parking the child or requiring a reply
- confirm `/minions` drill-down still works
- confirm the final model-visible packet says group idle/adjudicate, not completed
- confirm reviewer findings are adjudicated rather than accepted verbatim
- switch theme or otherwise invalidate rendering and verify no stale colors/overflow

Record the smoke result in the issue comment/handoff; do not build browser/TUI automation solely for this check.

## Quality gates

Run clean:
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run test`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run build`

No residual warnings without justified ignores. Close sbdpi-8b2.9 and sbdpi-8b2.10 only after independent review of their exact commits, then complete this integrated acceptance and real TUI smoke before closing the epic.

comments.text: Independent review of a3c050f found three required remediation items before acceptance: (1) high: test trusts scripted implementer/reviewer prose and never validates named commit contents with real git inspection; add test-only terminal SHA extraction + actual git show evidence and gate reviewer settlement on it, without production heuristics/schema. (2) medium: proposal docs still claim living authority/prescribe legacy role and lack explicit historical/superseded banners; point to package READMEs/migration as authoritative without rewriting historical bodies. (3) low but acceptance-relevant: manager-only no-edit assertion is tautological because harness does not observe edit/write; replace false proof with an observable parent coding-tool boundary or remove the claim and prove the prompt boundary accurately. Root gates currently pass. All three are dispositioned FIX because #1/#2 block closure and #3 otherwise leaves acceptance item 5 only partially proved.

Correction after parent adjudication: reviewer finding #1 is REJECTED, not FIX. A no-model scripted harness cannot prove semantic reviewer judgment, and adding test-owned `git show`/commit-content verification would build a second review mechanism, couple the scenario to Git fixture implementation details, and introduce shared-checkout/concurrent-commit assumptions. The acceptance boundary is protocol: implementer settles with a named SHA; only afterward the reviewer is launched with that exact SHA and explicit inspection instructions; the parent then applies review policy. Runtime child/reviewer claims remain untrusted and require parent adjudication, but this integration test must not simulate trust by inventing production commit heuristics. Do not add commit parsing, Git inspection, or fabricated-claim rejection tests. Finding #2 remains a valid narrow docs FIX. Finding #3 is valid only insofar as the tautological no-edit assertion should be removed/qualified; do not add broad coding-tool instrumentation. The prior comment's all-three-FIX disposition is superseded.

Minimal parent fix committed as 6bfc7e3. Reviewer finding #1 remains rejected: no test-owned Git inspection or commit heuristics were added. Applied only the accepted surgical changes: both proposal docs now carry explicit historical/superseded banners and point to authoritative package/migration docs; the stale living-spec claim is removed; the pre-implementation handoff is time-qualified; the two tautological parent edit/write assertions were deleted without adding tool instrumentation. Focused acceptance passes (1 file/5 tests), git diff check passed, and current-HEAD root lint/test/typecheck/build all pass.

Re-review source audit found no source defect: historical-doc and assertion-boundary fixes are correct, sequencing/manager assertions remain, scope is exact, rejected Git-inspection design was not reintroduced. Reviewer returned NEEDS_FIXES only because it invoked Vitest with the wrong path from the workspace cwd and stopped. Disposition: REJECT as a source finding; this is reviewer command error, not implementation remediation. Parent already ran the correct workspace-relative focused command successfully (1 file/5 tests) and the current-HEAD root lint/test/typecheck/build chain successfully at 6bfc7e3. No retry or code change required. Automated vertical slice accepted subject only to the issue's manual persistent-TUI smoke.

Real persistent-TUI smoke reached goal mode after cleaning ignored local .pi/beadwork-config.json to current review.policy-only shape. Built-in worker/investigate resolved; two simultaneous live children shared workItemId; widget showed pending/running/activity and cleared; child-to-parent notification did not park sender; one group-idle adjudication packet arrived; reviewer launched afterward. Reviewer surfaced two valid product-correctness gaps: successful automatic retry can strand reentrant evidence, and parentMessage nudge may claim 'has not settled'/stillRunning while coalesced terminal+group-idle evidence proves otherwise. Smoke stopped read-only after the nested parent attempted remediation instead of reporting. No repository diff remains. sbdpi-8b2.9 must reopen for targeted fixes before final smoke.

FINAL ACCEPTANCE PASS at HEAD 2381edf673d38d3132827d74d2d9692bb91eedea.

Automated: root `npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build` passed after all fixes; focused pi-minions 332 tests and agent-friendly E2E 5 tests passed; sbdpi-8b2.9/.10 exact commits independently reviewed PASS.

Real persistent Pi TUI: local ignored `.pi/beadwork-config.json` was migrated from rejected supervisor leftovers to `{review:{policy:"ticket"}}`. `beadwork_start_goal` started epic and queued continuation. Group grp-c866c559 accepted bundled worker ff65dade and investigate e302bc03 concurrently with the same workItemId sbdpi-8b2.7. Widget showed pending/running/tool/thinking states and cleared at idle. Worker notification packet said only `A child sent a notification. No reply is required.`; no live/not-settled claim, no parent reply, and sender settled normally. Final packet had zero running and `Group idle ... Inspect the evidence and decide the next action`, with no success/closure claim. Reviewer 74e7b1a2 launched only after idle in the same group; runtime nudge said findings are evidence to assess against product goals/constraints, not instructions to accept verbatim, and prohibited adversarial expansion without product confirmation. Parent rejected the intentionally unnecessary adjudication-event hardening and made no edits/mutations. Repo remained clean. Prior sbdpi-8b2.5 TUI smoke separately covers narrow width, theme invalidation, `/minions` drill-down, and session lifecycle. Group was forgotten, goal mode abandoned back to interactive, and all interactive-shell sessions cleaned up.

title: Prove and publish the agent-friendly orchestration vertical slice
